tooltip.battle-chickens.ominous_egg.desc: Initiates the 7-day Chicken Purge event at Threat Level I.
tooltip.battle-chickens.ominous_egg.usag: Right-click on the ground to begin the apocalypse.
tooltip.battle-chickens.gilded_ominous_e: Initiates the Chicken Purge at Threat Level II.
Right-click to start. Spawns tougher military chicken squads.
tooltip.battle-chickens.cursed_ominous_e: Initiates the Chicken Purge at Threat Level III.
Right-click to start. Victory unlocks the Veteran Rooster trader.
tooltip.battle-chickens.warlord_ominous_: Initiates the Chicken Purge at Threat Level IV (Hardcore).
Right-click to start. Daily Rations Crates are disabled.
Threat IV | Requires Rank III to craft
tooltip.battle-chickens.singularity_omin: Initiates the Chicken Purge at supreme Threat Level V.
Right-click to start. The ultimate apocalyptic test of survival.
Threat V | Maximum enemy stats & unlimited artillery
tooltip.battle-chickens.war_feather.desc: Hardened military plumage collected from Purge chickens.
tooltip.battle-chickens.war_feather.usag: Core ingredient for battle-tech weapons, armor, and gear.
tooltip.battle-chickens.war_feather.stat: Dropped by hostile Purge chickens and outposts
tooltip.battle-chickens.scrap_plate.desc: Heavy reinforced metal plating stripped from Purge armor.
tooltip.battle-chickens.scrap_plate.usag: Used in crafting the Cluck Shield, Bunker Blocks, and tech upgrades.
tooltip.battle-chickens.scrap_plate.stat: Dropped by Riot Chickens and Salvage Outposts
tooltip.battle-chickens.scrap_circuit.de: Salvaged microprocessor from specialized military units.
tooltip.battle-chickens.scrap_circuit.us: Used to craft Cluck Radar, Signal Scramblers, and Defense Cores.
tooltip.battle-chickens.scrap_circuit.st: Dropped by RPG Chickens, Snipers, and Medics
tooltip.battle-chickens.rocket_casing.de: Empty propulsion shell engineered for high-yield rockets.
tooltip.battle-chickens.rocket_casing.us: Craft into Dud Rockets using gunpowder and paper.
Concentrated volatile gunpowder sealed in a reinforced pouch.
Fuel for the Flame Fryer and explosive crafting.
tooltip.battle-chickens.golden_feather.d: Shimmering golden feather recovered from elite Purge commanders.
tooltip.battle-chickens.golden_feather.u: High-tier crafting currency used to trade with the Veteran Rooster.
tooltip.battle-chickens.golden_feather.s: Dropped by Purge Generals and Bosses
tooltip.battle-chickens.generals_plume.d: Imposing crest awarded for slaying a Purge General.
tooltip.battle-chickens.generals_plume.u: Wear as a helmet to gain Strength near Purge enemies, or display in a frame.
tooltip.battle-chickens.generals_plume.s: Grants Strength I when Purge chickens are within 16 blocks
tooltip.battle-chickens.overlord_shard.d: Resonating crystalline fragment harvested from the Chicken Overlord.
tooltip.battle-chickens.overlord_shard.u: Used to craft Singularity Ominous Eggs and master-tier rewards.
tooltip.battle-chickens.overlord_shard.s: Guaranteed drop from defeating the Day 7 Overlord
tooltip.battle-chickens.overlord_core.de: Supercharged mechanical power core of the Chicken Overlord.
tooltip.battle-chickens.overlord_core.us: Right-click to call an Orbital Strike. Sneak-Right-Click a block to deploy a Defense Core.
tooltip.battle-chickens.overlord_core.st: Orbital Strike: Massive Area Blast | Defense Core: Permanent Area Shield
tooltip.battle-chickens.scarecrow_turret: Armor-stand sentry dressed as a pumpkin-headed crossbow scarecrow.
Place on solid ground. Right-click it with wheat seeds to reload (16 shots/seed).
Automatically zaps hostile Purge chickens | 64 rounds | 16-block range
tooltip.battle-chickens.defense_core.des: Fortified beacon that projects a protective aura and repels Purge units.
tooltip.battle-chickens.defense_core.usa: Place to grant nearby players Resistance and zap approaching chickens.
tooltip.battle-chickens.radar_coop.desc: Recon station that marks nearby hostiles or reveals nearby players.
tooltip.battle-chickens.radar_coop.usage: Purge-placed: grants nearby Purge chickens Strength. Player-placed: grants Speed and reveals Purge chickens.
tooltip.battle-chickens.jammer_coop.desc: Signal jammer that interferes with enemies in range.
tooltip.battle-chickens.jammer_coop.usag: Purge-placed: buffs chickens, weakens players, and jams Cluck Radar. Player-placed: slows and weakens Purge chickens.
tooltip.battle-chickens.shield_coop.desc: Defensive field generator that protects its side and weakens enemies.
tooltip.battle-chickens.shield_coop.usag: Purge-placed: buffs chickens and weakens players. Player-placed: grants Resistance and weakens Purge chickens.
tooltip.battle-chickens.nemesis_trophy.d: Monument of triumph carved after slaying a persistent Nemesis Chicken.
tooltip.battle-chickens.nemesis_trophy.u: Place in an item frame or display on a wall as a badge of honor.
tooltip.battle-chickens.nemesis_trophy.s: Inscribed with the Nemesis chicken's rank and kill count
tooltip.battle-chickens.overlord_crown.d: The supreme gilded crown of the Chicken Overlord.
tooltip.battle-chickens.overlord_crown.u: Wear as a helmet to project a Strength aura to nearby allies, or display in a frame.
tooltip.battle-chickens.overlord_crown.s: Aura: Strength I for all allies within 12 blocks
tooltip.battle-chickens.rations_crate.de: Emergency airdrop supply crate delivered at each Purge dawn.
tooltip.battle-chickens.rations_crate.us: Right-click to open and unpack rations, medical supplies, and ammo.
tooltip.battle-chickens.rations_crate.st: Not delivered during Threat IV/V or Hardcore mode
tooltip.battle-chickens.dud_rocket.usage: Ammunition consumed when firing the Captured Peckzooka.
tooltip.battle-chickens.dud_rocket.stat: Deals heavy direct and splash explosive damage
tooltip.battle-chickens.purge_grenade.de: Tactical fragmentation grenade with a 2-second fuse.
tooltip.battle-chickens.purge_grenade.us: Right-click to lob into enemy squads. Explodes on a timed fuse.
tooltip.battle-chickens.purge_grenade.st: Blast Radius: 3.5 Blocks | Deals high shrapnel damage
tooltip.battle-chickens.flockwar_horn.de: Ancient warhorn carved from hardened bone and horn.
tooltip.battle-chickens.flockwar_horn.us: Right-click to sound the horn and rally nearby allies.
tooltip.battle-chickens.flockwar_horn.st: Grants Speed II and Haste II to nearby players for 30s | 60s CD
tooltip.battle-chickens.captured_peckzoo: Shoulder-mounted artillery cannon captured from RPG Chickens.
Right-click to launch high-explosive Dud Rockets.
tooltip.battle-chickens.cluck_shield.des: Reinforced blast shield forged with Scrap Plates.
tooltip.battle-chickens.cluck_shield.usa: Hold in either hand to reduce explosion damage, resist knockback, and reflect direct rockets.
tooltip.battle-chickens.feather_cloak.de: Lightweight aerodynamic cape spun from war feathers.
tooltip.battle-chickens.feather_cloak.us: Hold or equip to gain Slow Falling and complete fall damage immunity.
tooltip.battle-chickens.feather_cloak.st: Negates 100% of fall damage while held or worn
tooltip.battle-chickens.emp_disruptor.de: Electromagnetic pulse emitter tuned to Purge electronics.
tooltip.battle-chickens.emp_disruptor.us: Right-click to trigger an EMP shockwave around you.
tooltip.battle-chickens.emp_disruptor.st: Stuns nearby units for 5s & instantly dismantles Coops | 45s CD
tooltip.battle-chickens.egg_cannon.desc: Pneumatic cannon that fires pressurized concussive egg rounds.
tooltip.battle-chickens.egg_cannon.usage: Right-click with eggs in inventory to fire high-impact projectiles.
tooltip.battle-chickens.egg_cannon.stat: Extreme knockback force against advancing swarms
tooltip.battle-chickens.flak_cannon.desc: Short-barrel combat shotgun loaded with shrapnel pellets.
tooltip.battle-chickens.flak_cannon.usag: Right-click to unleash a wide spray of anti-air shrapnel.
tooltip.battle-chickens.flak_cannon.stat: Triple damage against airborne gunships and Phantoms
tooltip.battle-chickens.beak_47.desc: High-cadence assault rifle chambered in wheat seeds.
tooltip.battle-chickens.beak_47.usage: Hold right-click to unleash rapid seed bursts at targets.
tooltip.battle-chickens.rooster_spear.de: Long-reach halberd tipped with hardened war steel.
tooltip.battle-chickens.rooster_spear.us: Attack enemies from safety with extended reach.
tooltip.battle-chickens.rooster_spear.st: Reach: +2.0 Blocks | +50% Bonus damage to airborne enemies
tooltip.battle-chickens.flame_fryer.desc: Scorching flamethrower pressurized by Gunpowder Pouches.
tooltip.battle-chickens.flame_fryer.usag: Hold right-click to project a continuous cone of searing flames.
tooltip.battle-chickens.sniper_beak.desc: Extreme-range precision rifle with an optical targeting scope.
tooltip.battle-chickens.sniper_beak.usag: Right-click with arrows in inventory to fire high-velocity rounds.
tooltip.battle-chickens.riot_helmet.desc: Reinforced riot helmet with a heavy blast visor.
tooltip.battle-chickens.riot_helmet.usag: Wear as helmet to deflect incoming frontal arrows and gain Resistance.
tooltip.battle-chickens.riot_helmet.stat: Blocks 100% frontal projectile damage while guarding
tooltip.battle-chickens.reactive_plating: Keep anywhere in your inventory to dampen explosive blast damage.
Passively reduces incoming explosive damage by 30%
tooltip.battle-chickens.medic_syringe.de: Combat adrenaline injector salvaged from Medic Hens.
tooltip.battle-chickens.medic_syringe.us: Right-click to inject adrenaline and rapidly treat wounds.
tooltip.battle-chickens.medic_syringe.st: Instantly heals 6 HP + Regeneration II for 6s | Stack of 16
tooltip.battle-chickens.drumstick_of_val: Deep-fried champion drumstick blessed with ferocious vigor.
Eat to satisfy all hunger and fortify your body for battle.
Restores full food + Absorption & Strength for 60s
tooltip.battle-chickens.cluck_radar.desc: Tactical biometric radar that detects Purge squad movements.
tooltip.battle-chickens.cluck_radar.usag: Right-click to scan a 64-block perimeter for Purge hostiles.
tooltip.battle-chickens.cluck_radar.stat: Reports nearby unit counts, roles, and distance in chat
tooltip.battle-chickens.signal_scrambler: Portable broadcast scrambler that jams hostile targeting sensors.
Hold in hand to confuse enemy sniper lock-on and rocket tracking.
Prevents snipers and bosses from acquiring lock-on
tooltip.battle-chickens.golden_egg.desc: Radiant golden egg laid by surviving chickens after the Overlord falls.
tooltip.battle-chickens.golden_egg.usage: Right-click on the ground to hatch a rideable, loyal Giga Chicken!
tooltip.battle-chickens.golden_egg.stat: Hatches the ultimate feathered war mount
tooltip.battle-chickens.generator_core.d: Electromagnetic core harvested from Day 5+ Golem Walkers.
tooltip.battle-chickens.generator_core.u: Used with war feathers and scrap plates to forge the Flockguard Sigil.
tooltip.battle-chickens.flockguard_sigil: Ancient warding talisman forged to resist the Chicken Overlord.
Hold in either hand to brace against incoming attacks.
100% Knockback Resistance & -40% damage from all chickens
tooltip.battle-chickens.lasso.desc: Rips up and hurls a flat 3x3 boulder along a ballistic arc.
tooltip.battle-chickens.lasso.usage: Aim higher to throw farther; the boulder falls and explodes on impact.
tooltip.battle-chickens.scrap_bench.desc: Field crafting table for assembling Purge tech and blueprints.
tooltip.battle-chickens.scrap_bench.usag: Place and right-click to open the crafting grid.
tooltip.battle-chickens.bunker_block.des: Exceptionally durable fortification that resists ordinary mining and siege damage.
tooltip.battle-chickens.bunker_block.usa: Siege blasts and rams crack it after 256 hits and break it after 1,024. Lasso impacts cannot damage it.
tooltip.battle-chickens.bunker_block.sta: High mining and blast resistance | Cracks at 256, breaks at 1,024 siege hits
